action.purpose: Invoke one command with a text button or an icon button, never competing text and icons.

appearance-root.purpose: Apply the chosen appearance to the whole page and publish the system colour scheme.

artwork-placeholder.purpose: Stand in for the missing cover artwork of audio or poster of video with the glyph of its media kind.

attention-indicator.purpose: Mark objects needing attention with the same amber indicator everywhere, steady when reduced motion is enabled.

availability.purpose: Understand whether a capability is ready, unavailable or not yet known.

avatar.purpose: Show a person or identity as a seeded drawing, a picture or initials, optionally as the button that shuffles its seed.

card.purpose: Open one item, media, collection or summary from a card composed of artwork and its supporting content.

character-counter.purpose: Count the characters of a text value, or how many remain before its limit and by how many it is over.

choice.purpose: Choose one or several options given as data, as rows, cards, swatches or a menu, with a persistent label.

choice-item.purpose: Lay out one choice as its selection mark beside a title and an optional description.

choice-list.purpose: Hold the rows of a single or multiple choice in one transparent geometry inside its host.

choice-row.purpose: One pressable row of a choice list whose label activates the checkbox or radio it holds.

clear-input.purpose: Empty a text control in one press, keeping its masks and undo history, shown only while it holds a value.

clock.purpose: Show today's date and the current time, kept current while shown.

color-bullet.purpose: Show a label’s color alongside its text without using color as its only meaning.

column.purpose: Stack pieces vertically with a gap from the spacing scale, at the reading, narrow or wide measure, aligned or centred.

date-control.purpose: Choose one day from a month calendar opened from a labelled field well, within optional bounds.

destination-row.purpose: A grouped row that opens one destination, or shows why that destination is unavailable.

drawer.purpose: Open a temporary surface over its parent with content and top or bottom toolbars, never lateral child surfaces.

drawer-grip.purpose: The handle of a bottom-edge drawer that closes it by drag or press, disabled while the drawer is locked.

face.purpose: A round decorative mark that identifies a title or an option by icon, document, status, symbol or flag.

fact-list.purpose: One pane holding fact rows as a description list.

fact-row.purpose: Keep a capitalized label on the left and its value or its control right-aligned, with shared horizontal dividers and balanced wrapping.

fact-value.purpose: Read one scalar fact as text, or show that it is unknown or empty with a muted icon and an accessible state.

feedback.purpose: A short status sentence, announced politely, that tells the person what just happened.

field.purpose: Write a single line or several, or open a choice, in one labelled well with field help and validation feedback.

field-well.purpose: Frame one editor in a rounded well whose label floats when empty and settles above the value when filled or focused.

field-well-content.purpose: Keep a field's label persistently above its editor or value, as a label for the editor or as text inside a button.

files.purpose: Select supported local files and inspect their limits before an operation uses them.

form.purpose: Submit a labelled group of fields together, from any of its fields or its submit action.

gallery.purpose: Page through a set of photos in place, inline, heading a place or as a detail's photograph, and open them in the viewer.

grid.purpose: Lay pieces out in auto-fitted tracks of one recipe (tiles, collections, cards, covers, results) with a gap from the spacing scale.

grouped-panel.purpose: Hold sibling rows in one shared pane, at the reading measure or the full overview width.

heading.purpose: A title whose meaning picks its type role and level: display, page, section or field group.

icon.purpose: Draw one named glyph of the product's icon set, optionally toned, sized to the text or placed inside a control.

image.purpose: Show a public or private image at the rendition its frame needs, hidden until decoded, with a fallback and optional retry, or the placeholder of missing artwork.

inline.purpose: Lay pieces out in a horizontal sequence with a gap from the spacing scale: wrapping, in a labelled scroll rail, or neither.

label-rail.purpose: Present selected labels in a wrapping rail using the same value representation as the field.

list.purpose: Hold sibling rows or facts in one shared pane, at the reading measure or the full overview width.

loading.purpose: Show that content is on its way, as skeleton lines or a spinner, and announce it by its label.

masked-input.purpose: Edit a masked value such as a decimal amount: format while typing, keep the caret and undo, report the canonical value.

measured-field.purpose: Give one form control the preferred measure of its family inside the available space, with its invalid and disabled state.

media-player.purpose: Play a video or audio item with its transport, seek and volume controls, showing artwork for audio and a retry when unavailable.

media-viewer.purpose: Show images, audio and video full screen with paging, zoom and playback, and return focus to what opened them.

menu.purpose: Reveal overflowing contextual commands beside their readable labels, without putting content navigation in the toolbar.

message-body.purpose: Read a surface frame's message as a status paragraph, or as the description of a message dialog.

meter.purpose: Show a total split into labelled segments: the total, a bar proportional to each segment and the legend.

modal.purpose: Present a temporary surface over its parent, dismissed by Escape, its scrim or its grip unless locked.

photo-collection.purpose: Page through a set of photos in place and open them in the full-screen viewer.

picker-sheet.purpose: Present a picker as a bottom sheet with a grip and a close toolbar, returning focus to its trigger on dismissal.

place.purpose: Arrange content and top or bottom toolbars, with lateral surfaces only at the root. Mounted surfaces keep their own content and toolbars.

place-heading.purpose: Head a place, or content embedded in one, with its title, subtitle and optional featured media.

playback-canvas.purpose: Play a video or audio item attached to its playback controller, showing artwork for audio and a retry when unavailable.

playback-controls.purpose: Play, pause, mute, set the volume of and seek a media playback, one part at a time.

popover.purpose: Open contextual content, a form, options or commands in a surface anchored to its trigger.

reference-values.purpose: Read selected object references using their labels and shared value layout.

retained-place.purpose: Keep a place mounted while hidden and provide whether it is the active surface.

row.purpose: Open one object or destination from a list row, or read one, and say why an unavailable one cannot open.

scroll-edges.purpose: Fade the edges of a scroll viewport under its toolbars while there is content left to scroll there.

search-field.purpose: Type a query in a search well with a search icon and a clear button.

seed-avatar.purpose: Generate a deterministic visual identity from a seed without displaying letters or initials.

selection-field.purpose: Choose one value from a list of options, inline, as a field well or as a contextual value.

separator.purpose: Draw a hairline in the separator ink between the pieces of a column or a row, optionally inset like grouped rows.

shell.purpose: Host a workspace place with its navigation sidebar, toolbars, search overlay, panels and failure dialog.

slider.purpose: Set one bounded value along a track, such as a playback position or a volume.

spacer.purpose: Leave an empty space of one spacing step, or take the space a row or column leaves over.

stack-item.purpose: Place one entry of a stack at the content or the surface inset.

stack-layout.purpose: Group related content under one title, with an optional description and required mark.

status.purpose: Say why there is nothing to show (empty, offline, a note) and what to do next, as a block or a compact caption.

surface.purpose: Arrange content and top or bottom toolbars, with lateral surfaces only at the root. Mounted surfaces keep their own content and toolbars.

tag.purpose: Show one label as a toned chip, removable when its owner allows, or a reference as its name beside its color.

text.purpose: A paragraph of plain text in a type role and tone, optionally announced as a status or inset to align with rows.

text-input.purpose: Write a single line or several with a persistent label, field help and validation feedback.

theme-preview.purpose: Compare Dark and Light using the same surface, tint and wallpaper tokens as the running interface.

toolbar-layout.purpose: Keep navigation and contextual commands in the surface toolbar; reveal its title and subtitle only after the content header scrolls away.

toolbar-media-controls.purpose: Show transport, media thumbnails and volume for the media selected in a toolbar.

toolbar-search.purpose: Search the items of a toolbar's place: a search field revealed by a toggle that also closes the search.

view-region.purpose: Frame one view's content, one of its items, a place's document or a retained place with the identity navigation reveals; bare renders content unframed.

viewer.purpose: Show images, audio and video full screen with paging, zoom and playback controls.

wallpaper.purpose: Provide system-generated Silk, Mist or Plain backgrounds that follow the selected appearance.

zoom-controls.purpose: Step a media view's zoom out or in between 100% and its maximum, and reset it from the shown percentage.
